subject: /workspaces/bmad-multi-user/skills/team-claim
verdict: Lean soft-ownership board with solid claims.py; two highs — builder .memlog.md at root and on_complete underwired beyond interactive Claim.
summary: team-claim matches sibling soft-skill shape: claims.py owns claim/release/check/list, SKILL.md judges intent and soft UX, customize.toml is universal-only. Ship polish: wire on_complete on every terminal, trim headless JSON ceremony and vague soft-offer check, and accept (or exclude) builder .memlog.md like siblings.

themes.title: Terminal-hook and headless contract gaps
themes.root_cause: on_complete and headless envelopes are documented for Claim interactive/success paths but not uniformly for Release, Check/list, blocked exits, and list intent — automators and overrides get silent no-ops.
themes.action: One terminal rule: after every Claim/Release/Check/list exit (interactive+headless, complete+blocked), run on_complete if set; replace JSON fences with a compact key contract plus list/blocked envelopes.

themes.title: Builder memlog vs path-standards
themes.root_cause: Builder process memory lives at skill root as .memlog.md; scanner allows only SKILL.md there — same accepted pattern as team-ready/team-gates/team-status.
themes.action: Leave .memlog.md in place for resume; clear the fail only if ship lint requires excluding it from the root-*.md check or packaged contents.

themes.title: Vague soft-offer and soft restatement
themes.root_cause: Soft-offer check after claim is gated by 'when useful'; soft/don't-block is restated after Overview already set the bar.
themes.action: Remove soft-offer check (or pin to claimed|takeover only with headless soft_offer); drop soft restatements.

strengths: Deterministic claim/release/check/list via claims.py with conflict/--force/takeover
Soft-only bar in Overview; headless conflict → blocked without inventing ownership
customize.toml sole mechanism, universal defaults only
Tokens 1143 under budget; integrity + scripts clean; simple-workflow topology
Smoke-tested against real planning brief path

recommendations.action: Wire {workflow.on_complete} after every terminal Claim/Release/Check/list (interactive+headless); add list + blocked envelopes; compact headless key contract
Remove vague soft-offer check (or pin claimed|takeover + soft_offer) and soft restatements
Accept or exclude builder .memlog.md from path-standards like siblings

journeys.name: Headless claim free
journeys.steps: target+actor → claims.py claim → complete JSON with action claimed

journeys.name: Headless claim conflict
journeys.steps: other actor holds target → blocked JSON conflict true; --force → takeover

journeys.name: Interactive release stale
journeys.steps: anyone release → claim removed; no actor match required

experience.headless: Claim/release/check work when paths explicit; list and some blocked envelopes underspecified; on_complete may no-op outside interactive Claim.

findings.title: Headless JSON examples are format ceremony
findings.evidence: Three near-identical full JSON envelopes with empty claim: {} placeholders. Script JSON already carries action/claim/conflict; skill only adds status/intent/memlog wrapping.
findings.recommendation: Replace JSON fences with one headless envelope contract naming required keys and blocked-vs-complete rules; keep script output as field source.
findings.proposed_smallest: Headless: emit {status: complete|blocked, intent, target, memlog} plus script fields (action/claim/conflict/released/claimed/reason as applicable). Conflict without --force → blocked; do not invent ownership.
findings.predicted_delta: Likely nothing material if consumers read keys not formatting; route to variant eval to confirm.

findings.title: Soft/don't-block editing restated after Overview bar
findings.evidence: Overview already sets soft-only bar; Claim/Check repeat do-not-hard-block and soft-offer-check-when-useful.
findings.recommendation: Drop soft restatements and vague soft-offer-check line; keep conflict/--force/no-silent-overwrite and on_complete where they add non-obvious failure modes.

findings.title: Prompt file at skill root: .memlog.md
findings.evidence: path-standards reports high: .memlog.md at skill root (only SKILL.md allowed). Same builder process-memory convention as team-ready/team-gates/team-status; not workflow content, but scanner still fails.
findings.recommendation: Keep as builder memlog beside SKILL.md (do not move to references/). Clear path-standards fail by excluding .memlog.md from root-*.md check or packaged contents if ship lint must be green.

findings.title: on_complete only on interactive Claim
findings.evidence: customize.toml exposes on_complete. SKILL.md runs {workflow.on_complete} only in Claim Interactive; Release, Check/list, and headless Claim never reference it — override silently no-ops.
findings.recommendation: After every successful and blocked-as-terminal Claim/Release/Check/list exit—interactive and headless—run {workflow.on_complete} if non-empty.

findings.title: remove or pin vague soft-offer check after claim
findings.evidence: Soft-offer check after successful claim gated only by 'only when useful'; headless success has no soft_offer. Successful claim JSON already confirms the write.
findings.recommendation: Remove soft-offer check, or pin to action claimed|takeover only with headless soft_offer: check; omit on already and conflict-blocked.

findings.title: add missing headless envelopes for list and non-claim failures
findings.evidence: list is a first-class intent but only check headless success is documented; Release/check omit blocked envelopes that siblings provide per intent.
findings.recommendation: Add headless complete for list; add blocked JSON for release and check/list script-or-path failures with matching intent.
